header.description: The logit lens at every layer, in one forward: `layers: "all"` reads the residual stream at the answer position at each layer of the model and projects each through the final norm and head, so `lens.logits` is one value with the layer axis first — (layers, rows, 1, vocab). A metric of it scores each layer, and its table has a row per layer and example, each saying its layer. logit_lens.json is the same lens as one point per layer; the numbers are the same.
